summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA211765 (UBRELVY/ubrogepant). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled trials using designs similar to previously approved acute migraine drugs, and the safety profile was acceptable without controversial issues. The Medical Review likewise states an advisory committee meeting was not anticipated, so there were no AdComm concerns or resulting changes to the approval.
